notes.title: 0.13 Version Update
notes.content:
1、 Fixed numerous bugs.

2、 Added Korean and Russian translations (translations still need optimization).

New content and other bug fixes will be implemented in next month's update.

notes.title: Version 0.12 Update:
notes.content:
1.Bug Fixes: Fixed issues with keybindings and technology tree values.
2.Enhanced Features: Improved breast physics simulation (further improvements to come).
3.Visual Enhancements: Improved the visuals of certain scenes.
4.New Content: Added new adult content.

We will continue to update this month to fix known bugs and add support for more languages. More exciting content is planned for release next month.

notes.title: Thanks for your support
notes.content:
As an early access title, we understand that the current version has many issues that need to be addressed, and we need to add more game content. Therefore, we offer a free demo and a 20% discount for early adopters. If you are still unsatisfied, please feel free to leave your valuable feedback or request a refund according to the platform's policy. We appreciate you playing our game. We hope you will follow us and add the game to your wishlist to see our future updates.

Regarding our future update plans, we will be releasing several updates to fix the most serious bugs and translation issues as soon as possible, and we will also add more H content. We welcome suggestions from all players regarding future game content, such as adding more white or black stockings, or more outfits. We will give more weight to the opinions of players who have already purchased the game.

Regarding the game pricing, the 20% discount is the most favorable price before the official release. In the future, there may be some promotional activities, but there will not be such a large discount. And there will be no promotional activities in the short term. This is mainly to protect the interests of the first batch of players who support us. We hope all players can understand. Thank you.
